mechanism: cancelUntilFits sorts reservations oldest-first instead of newest-first; with 100 g available and holds of 60 g then 50 g, it cancels the older reservation rather than the newer 50 g reservation required by policy.
trigger: After consumption, available stock is 100 g; an older reservation holds 60 g and a newer reservation holds 50 g.
expectedBehavior: Cancel the newer 50 g reservation first; the older reservation can remain because 60 g fits.
incorrectBehavior: Cancel the older reservation first, leaving the newer reservation active even though policy requires newest-first cancellation.
reproduction: Call the before and after fixture with {"reservations": [{"id": "older", "grams": 60, "createdAt": 1}, {"id": "newer", "grams": 50, "createdAt": 2}], "available": 100}; compare the result to verify the described behavior.
unacceptableAllegations: the fixture directly executes a production database migration
the fixture proves unrelated application behavior
